Let S_k(A) = {cities B : (M^k)_{A,B} > 0} = set of cities reachable from A in exactly k steps.

By Hall's theorem, an antitour exists iff for every subset T ⊆ {1,...,50}, |∪_{k∈T} (complement of S_k(A))| ≥ |T|, i.e., |∩_{k∈T} S_k(A)| ≤ 50 - |T|.
